name: PANDA Docker — fill these in
description:
Fill in `baseUrl`, `apiKey` and `kid` before running the collection. Nothing here is a real credential, and nothing here points at a shared service — every organization runs its own instance.

`apiKey` is typed as a secret, so Postman keeps it out of the variable list on screen. Keep it that way: a bearer key shown during a demo or caught in a screenshot is a key that has to be rotated.

`kid` must name a key your own deployment holds — ask whoever administers it. Leaving it empty will not work: the service does not fall back to a default key, and answers `unknown_kid` instead. The OpenAPI document currently says otherwise, which is a known discrepancy.

`plaintext` is a sample NIK for the requests to act on. Any value works; the tests assert the shape of the answer rather than the exact characters, so changing it will not break them.
